body:
A DTM map specifically designed for the tournament by Tanpopo and FluenZa. This features a ship layout with, TNT, redstone, diamonds, stale-ing gameplay, and supply chests. If some teams want to scrimmage on it, I've decided unlike the other maps to put up a public download.

Images - supply chest, tnt chest
